SAP Project Manager - Jobs  Ref: #75033 SAP Project Manager SAP Project Manager - European S/4HANA Rollout Freelance | ASAP start | 12 months+ | Netherlands/Belgium base, c. 75-80% European travel | English essential, Dutch a plus A global manufacturing group headquartered in the Netherlands is adding senior delivery capacity to its multi-country SAP S/4HANA programme. You'll lead country rollouts across eight to nine European markets - Belgium and the Netherlands at the core, plus Eastern and Southern Europe including Romania, Greece and Croatia - working on-site with local teams and reporting into the central programme. This is functional programme delivery, not a technical role: owning plan, scope, risks and stakeholder alignment across parallel country waves, coordinating the functional workstreams into the global template, and running cutover, go-live and hypercare. You'll need: 15+ years in SAP with a strong project/programme management track record, proven multi-country rollout experience (ideally S/4HANA template deployments), solid functional grounding across core SAP modules, fluent English, and the flexibility to travel most of the working week.
